verdict.rationale: The pack documents no native bulk or batch operations. The closest support is general programmatic automation: a CLI usable "through an automated system", a REST API with an OpenAPI description, and scoped access tokens. With these, an AI agent could script loops over many projects or deployments, but only as a workaround. The MCP tools are mostly list and get calls on single items, not multi-item actions. Missing for 10: native bulk or batch endpoints or commands, documented multi-item actions in the CLI, API or MCP, and any hands-on evidence of bulk workflows.
